headline: The Amalfi Coast in six scenes
editorial_intent: Original six-photo manually swipeable carousel correcting user criticism that a silent still-photo video was not a carousel. A varied Italian coast story with more striking daylight and blue-hour images.
reader_scenario: People planning a future Italy trip who want to swipe and inspect each remarkable sight at their own pace.
share_reason: Six location-specific, photographically diverse Amalfi Coast scenes with meaningful names, ideal for saving or sharing.
slide_count_rationale: Exactly six true independent high-quality original photo slides including a classic Positano cover and blue-hour closure; no empty CTA.
caption:
Six scenes that'll make you fall for the Amalfi Coast. 🍋🇮🇹

📍 Positano — layers of pastel houses and bougainvillea.
📍 Ravello — dreamy gardens above the Mediterranean.
📍 Fiordo di Furore — a tiny beach beneath a soaring stone bridge.
📍 Amalfi — beach umbrellas and afternoons by the water.
📍 Path of the Gods — hike above the spectacular coastline.
📍 Positano by night — the whole hillside begins to glow.

Which one would you see first? Save this for your Italian escape.

Photos: Ian Mackey, nella n., Milan Hamel, Margo Evardson, Sekwang Chia & Sebastian Leonhardt / Unsplash.
